notes: Tier bands are in GB (10240 GB = 10 TB). Transfer to other AWS services or regions is priced differently and is not modelled.

egress_fair_use.note: No fair-use rule for internet egress is stated on the S3 pricing page; egress beyond the 100 GB free allowance is billed per GB.

object_lock.note: S3 Object Lock uses a write-once-read-many model; requires versioning.

free_tier.value: New AWS customers (from 15 July 2025) receive up to USD 200 in AWS Free Tier credits usable on eligible services including Amazon S3; credits must be used within 12 months of account creation. The free plan lasts 6 months. No S3-specific free storage or request quantity is stated.
free_tier.note: Credits are account-wide, not an S3 allowance; not modelled in estimates. The 100 GB/month free internet egress is modelled under egress.

notes: All prices are list prices in USD before tax, taken from the machine-readable AWS per-region price list files named in each source note (AmazonS3 publicationDate 2026-10-12T23:11:02Z; AWSDataTransfer 2026-09-16T13:22:08Z; AmazonS3GlacierDeepArchive 2026-09-11T12:45:07Z). All eu-central-1 values were unchanged on 2026-10-13.
Storage prices are per GB-month as billed by AWS; the price list uses binary units internally, so treat GB and GiB as equivalent when estimating.
Prices differ per region: eu-north-1 is modelled only for S3 Standard (separate class entry) and internet egress.
